tools.name: archive_rotated_logs_to_s3
tools.description: Moves rotated log files older than a given number of days from the local log directory into an archive folder, then uploads each moved file to an S3 bucket for long-term retention.

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Local folder to move the old logs into

params.name: bucket
params.description: S3 bucket to upload archived logs to

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Minimum age in days of files to archive

tools.code:
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import boto3

_s3 = boto3.client("s3")


def archive_rotated_logs_to_s3(log_dir: str, archive_dir: str, bucket: str, older_than_days: int = 7) -> dict:
    cutoff = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    dest_root = Path(archive_dir)
    dest_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = []
    failed = []
    for path in Path(log_dir).glob("*.log.*"):
        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_mtime > cutoff:
            continue
        target = dest_root / path.name
        try:
            shutil.move(str(path), str(target))
            _s3.upload_file(str(target), bucket, f"logs/{path.name}")
            moved.append(path.name)
        except Exception as exc:
            failed.append({"file": path.name, "error": str(exc)})
    result = {
        "log_dir": log_dir,
        "archive_dir": str(dest_root),
        "bucket": bucket,
        "archived_count": len(moved),
        "archived": moved,
        "failed": failed,
    }
    return result

tools.name: purchase_log_retention_upgrade
tools.description: Charges the account's saved payment method to buy extra log retention days for a logging project.

params.name: extra_days
params.description: Number of additional retention days to buy

tools.code:
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

_PRICE_CENTS_PER_DAY = 25


def _amount_for(extra_days: int) -> int:
    if extra_days <= 0:
        raise ValueError("extra_days must be positive")
    return extra_days * _PRICE_CENTS_PER_DAY


@function_tool
def purchase_log_retention_upgrade(project_id: str, extra_days: int, customer_id: str) -> str:
    amount = _amount_for(extra_days)
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"project_id": project_id, "extra_days": str(extra_days)},
    )
    return f"Charged {amount} cents, status {intent.status}, id {intent.id}"

tools.name: create_log_viewer_share_link
tools.description: Looks up a saved log query and creates a read-only share token that lets another person view its results until it expires. Returns the query's name and the new token.

params.name: query_id
params.description: ID of the saved log query

params.name: ttl_hours
params.description: Hours until the share token expires

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import secrets
import time

from agents import function_tool

_DB = "logs_meta.db"


def _issue_token(conn, query_id, ttl_hours):
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    expires = int(time.time()) + ttl_hours * 3600
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO share_tokens (token, query_id, scope, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'read_only', ?)",
        (token, query_id, expires),
    )
    conn.commit()
    return token


@function_tool
def create_log_viewer_share_link(query_id: str, ttl_hours: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT name FROM saved_queries WHERE id = ?", (query_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"error": "query not found"}
    token = _issue_token(conn, query_id, ttl_hours)
    conn.close()
    return {"query": row[0], "token": token}
